nodes.title: Migrations suite substrate
nodes.summary: The manifest, lockfile, suite runner and production marker that let migrations/ be installed with npm ci and its tests/*.sql scripts run on an ephemeral Neon branch created from production.
unmet: The runner exits with code 0 when every test script passes.

nodes.title: 0007 test scripts rely on the applied schema
nodes.summary: The three compliance_deletion_affected test scripts under migrations/tests no longer load migration 0007 with \ir, so they run on a database where 0007 already stands.

nodes.title: Proof that the three 0007 scripts run on the applied schema
nodes.summary: The three existing compliance_deletion_affected scripts, which the suite runs on a branch where 0007 already stands, are offered as their own proof of the three run-without-error criteria. They also decide the affected-counts node.
